authenticatedTools.name: list_locations
authenticatedTools.title: List connected locations
authenticatedTools.description: List every location connected to this business across its review platforms (Google Business Profile, TripAdvisor).

businessId.description: For OAuth and owner-wide self-service sragt_ keys: which of the owner's businesses to act on. Omit it and, if the owner manages more than one, the call returns a business picker instead of doing the work: a SUCCESS result whose payload is { businesses: [...], hint: "..." }. Call again with businessId set to one of the returned businessId values. Ignored only for legacy/admin per-business credentials, which pin one business.

authenticatedTools.name: list_unanswered_reviews
authenticatedTools.title: List unanswered reviews
authenticatedTools.description: List reviews awaiting a reply for this business across all connected platforms, optionally scoped to one location and/or one provider. Each review includes its provider. Provider values are open-ended (e.g. google, tripadvisor; more appear as platforms are connected) — never hardcode the list.

businessId.description: For OAuth and owner-wide self-service sragt_ keys: which of the owner's businesses to act on. Omit it and, if the owner manages more than one, the call returns a business picker instead of doing the work: a SUCCESS result whose payload is { businesses: [...], hint: "..." }. Call again with businessId set to one of the returned businessId values. Ignored only for legacy/admin per-business credentials, which pin one business.

locationId.description: Optional location id to scope the list to.

provider.description: Optional provider slug to scope the list to (e.g. "google", "tripadvisor"). Unknown values return an empty list.

authenticatedTools.name: get_review_stats
authenticatedTools.title: Get review statistics
authenticatedTools.description: Read-only review KPIs for this business: totals, average rating, response rate, pending count, backlog, response speed on negative reviews, and a per-provider breakdown. Optionally scoped to one location and/or a trailing window of days (omit days for all-time). Provider keys in the breakdown are open-ended — new platforms appear automatically.

businessId.description: For OAuth and owner-wide self-service sragt_ keys: which of the owner's businesses to act on. Omit it and, if the owner manages more than one, the call returns a business picker instead of doing the work: a SUCCESS result whose payload is { businesses: [...], hint: "..." }. Call again with businessId set to one of the returned businessId values. Ignored only for legacy/admin per-business credentials, which pin one business.

locationId.description: Optional location id to scope the stats to.

days.description: Optional trailing window in days (e.g. 30). Omit for all-time.

authenticatedTools.name: get_review_context
authenticatedTools.title: Get review context
authenticatedTools.description: Get full context for a single review: text, business, language, provider (google or tripadvisor), and every drafted reply variant.

authenticatedTools.name: draft_reply
authenticatedTools.title: Draft AI reply variants
authenticatedTools.description: Generate StarReview AI reply variants for a pending review (Google or TripAdvisor) and save them as drafts. The agent only drafts and submits; it never posts. On later submission, an eligible unedited StarReview draft may be scheduled under the owner's existing approval/automatic-publishing settings when current Agent Consent and safety checks allow it; edited or safety-held replies remain pending.

reviewId.description: The pending review id to draft a reply for.

authenticatedTools.name: submit_reply_for_approval
authenticatedTools.title: Submit a drafted reply for approval
authenticatedTools.description: Submit one of StarReview's drafted variants (from `draft_reply`), optionally editing its text, so StarReview can apply the owner's approval and automatic-publishing policy. The agent submits and never posts. On a provider with a live posting API, an eligible unedited StarReview draft may be scheduled when that provider's owner settings, current Agent Consent, and safety checks allow it; agent-written, edited, or safety-held replies remain pending. A provider without a posting API always remains pending until a human approves it, after which the owner receives the manual-post link. To submit the agent's OWN reply text instead (no prior draft), use `submit_own_reply`.

reviewId.description: The review id the reply is being submitted for.

variant.description: Which drafted variant number (from draft_reply) to submit. Required.

finalText.description: Optional: overrides the chosen draft variant's text with this edited version.

preferredPostAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp: where a provider posting API is supported, StarReview will not post the reply before this time. Providers without a posting API still require the owner to post manually.

authenticatedTools.name: submit_own_reply
authenticatedTools.title: Submit your own reply for approval
authenticatedTools.description: Submit the agent's OWN reply text into the owner's approval queue, with no StarReview draft (no LLM call). It always requires human approval and NEVER auto-schedules — even on a positive, consented business. After approval, StarReview uses its own infrastructure only where the provider has a supported posting API; otherwise the owner posts through the returned manual-post link. The agent only drafts and submits. To submit one of StarReview's own drafts instead, use `submit_reply_for_approval`.

reviewId.description: The review id the reply is being submitted for.

finalText.description: The agent's own reply text. This IS the reply. Required.

preferredPostAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp: after human approval and where a provider posting API is supported, StarReview will not post the reply before this time. Providers without a posting API still require the owner to post manually.

publicTools.name: get_service_info
publicTools.title: About StarReview
publicTools.description: What StarReview does, pricing (CHF 0.50 per published reply, drafting is free), how a business signs up, and how an agent authenticates via OAuth.

publicTools.name: search_business
publicTools.title: Find a business on Google Maps
publicTools.description: Find a business on Google Maps by name, optionally with its city. Returns up to 5 candidates; feed the chosen candidate's placeId to check_response_rate.

query.description: Business name, optionally with city, e.g. "Restaurant Adler Zuerich".

publicTools.name: check_response_rate
publicTools.title: Check review response rate
publicTools.description: Free check: what share of this business's recent Google reviews received an owner reply, benchmarked against up to two nearby competitors. placeId must come from a recent search_business call. Results are cached for about 30 days; do not repeat the call for the same place.

lang.description: Optional locale for the check (default de).
